question: Should maintainers explicitly override the real-behavior-proof gate because this PR changes only a test mock and its exact behavior is demonstrated by the focused test and strict type-check lanes?
rationale: Repository policy requires real-setup proof for external non-docs PRs, but this patch has no production behavior to exercise independently; accepting its strong test/type-check evidence therefore requires explicit human intent.

options.title: Override Test-Only Proof
options.body: Confirm the exact-head focused checks, apply the proof override, and allow this narrow test-only repair to proceed.

options.title: Require Additional Proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until the contributor supplies maintainer-accepted evidence beyond tests and type checking.

recommendation.title: Override Test-Only Proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the exact-head focused checks, apply the proof override, and allow this narrow test-only repair to proceed.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is the original author of the affected replay-protection implementation and test surface.
